text:
maria.n: Quick heads-up — we plan to roll the 'ratepatch' pricing experiment for the early-access cohort tomorrow 07/01. This will bump embedded unit price +8% for the cohort. Need ops alignment: sales exemptions, invoice flags, and a rollback signal.
jonah.r: Can you confirm the exact eligibility rule? are we using the 'early_access' customer tag or a cohort list?
maria.n: primary is customer.tag == 'early_access'. fallback list attached in drive (pinged in #docs). Sales exemptions only for customers with active grandfathering=false. @sarah.k can you validate invoice impact for those with committed credits?
sarah.k: quick scan: vendor rate card change last week already caused a few usage delta rows. If we change price now some invoices will show token mismatches. I'll run a reconcile and post anomalies by EOD.
billing-bot: [automated] New experiment created: ratepatch | cohort=early_access | start=2026-07-01 | change=+8% | id=exp_20260701_ratepatch
alex.t: Ops notes — we should tag generated invoices with metadata: experiment=ratepatch so downstream analytics can filter. Also add invoice_note: "Early access pricing experiment — see billing portal".
zoe.p: Sales asks for an exemptions whitelist. What's the approval flow? Legal needs to sign off on exceptions > $50k ARR.
maria.n: exemptions flow: 1) rep adds case in SFDC with tag "ratepatch-exempt" 2) finance reviews/approves 3) legal approves if ARR > 50k. I'll paste a checklist in a minute.
jonah.r: For the billing pipeline change, propose a small migration: add field invoice.metadata.experiment and a boolean invoice.metadata.exempt. Minimal schema change — rollback is just flipping flag.
sarah.k: re reconcile plan: running delta job:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(usage_tokens * (new_price-old_price)) as est_delta
FROM billing.usage
WHERE customer_tag = 'early_access' AND window >= '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY est_delta DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
will post output.
alex.t: Also suggest we bump monitoring alert thresholds for daily delta to 2x for first 72 hours.
zoe.p: timeline aligned. Will coordinate sales comms + exemptions doc. Any objections to go live tomorrow morning (10am PT)?
maria.n: No objections from finance. If sarah flags >5 customers with >$10k deltas, we pause. :white_check_mark:
sarah.k: I'll publish the reconcile by 6pm PST. If anything critical, I'll @channel in here.
billing-bot: [automated] Experiment status scheduled: ratepatch -> scheduled for 1767952800 (2026-07-01 10:00:00 PT)
maria.n: Thanks all — final checklist posted in drive and linked in SFDC template. Will update if anything changes. :rocket:
